description: This file contains implementation of functions for manipulating socket addresses, including retrieving and comparing ports and addresses, setting ports, parsing strings into socket addresses, converting addresses to strings, and handling address information resolution.

methods.name: unsigned short sock_addr_get_port(const sock_addr * saddr)
methods.description: Returns the port number from a sockaddr structure, handling IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: int sock_addr_is_addr_wildcard(const sock_addr * saddr)
methods.description: Checks if the socket address is a wildcard address (INADDR_ANY for IPv4 or equivalent for IPv6).

methods.name: int sock_addr_is_family_eq(const sock_addr * saddr1,const sock_addr * saddr2)
methods.description: Compares if two socket addresses have the same address family.

methods.name: int sock_addr_is_port_eq(const sock_addr * saddr1,const sock_addr * saddr2)
methods.description: Checks if two socket addresses have the same port number.

methods.name: int sock_addr_is_addr_eq(const sock_addr * saddr1,const sock_addr * saddr2)
methods.description: Checks if two socket addresses have the same IP address.

methods.name: int sock_addr_is_addr_eq_bits(const sock_addr * a,const sock_addr * b,int bits)
methods.description: Checks if two IP addresses are equal up to a specified number of bits (subnet matching).

methods.name: void sock_addr_set_port(sock_addr * const restrict saddr,const unsigned short port)
methods.description: Sets the port number in a socket address structure.

methods.name: int sock_addr_assign(sock_addr * const restrict saddr,int family,unsigned short nport,const void * const restrict naddr)
methods.description: Initializes a socket address with given family, port, and address data.

methods.name: int sock_addr_inet_pton(sock_addr * const restrict saddr,const char * const restrict str,int family,unsigned short port)
methods.description: Converts a string IP address to a socket address in binary form, supporting IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: const char * sock_addr_inet_ntop(const sock_addr * const restrict saddr,char * const restrict buf,socklen_t sz)
methods.description: Converts a socket address to its string IP address representation, supporting IPv4, IPv6, and Unix domain sockets.

methods.name: int sock_addr_inet_ntop_copy_buffer(buffer * const restrict b,const sock_addr * const restrict saddr)
methods.description: Converts a socket address to string and copies it into a buffer.

methods.name: int sock_addr_inet_ntop_append_buffer(buffer * const restrict b,const sock_addr * const restrict saddr)
methods.description: Converts a socket address to string and appends it to a buffer.

methods.name: int sock_addr_stringify_append_buffer(buffer * const restrict b,const sock_addr * const restrict saddr)
methods.description: Creates a string representation of the socket address with port, appending to a buffer.

methods.name: int sock_addr_nameinfo_append_buffer(buffer * const restrict b,const sock_addr * const restrict saddr,log_error_st * const restrict errh)
methods.description: Performs hostname resolution for a socket address and appends the name or IP to a buffer.

methods.name: int sock_addr_from_str_hints(sock_addr * const restrict saddr,socklen_t * const restrict len,const char * const restrict str,int family,unsigned short port,log_error_st * const restrict errh)
methods.description: Parses a hostname or IP string into a socket address, with support for hints and resolution.

methods.name: int sock_addr_from_str_numeric(sock_addr * const restrict saddr,const char * const restrict str,log_error_st * const restrict errh)
methods.description: Parses a numeric IP address string into a socket address, with optional hostname resolution.
